summary: A visual survey of evidence-backed deepening candidates should be allowed to conclude there is no worthwhile refactor and should stop before unchosen design work.

supporting_disposition.reason: Retain visual candidate cards and before/after diagrams; use offline inline CSS/SVG, evidence labels, and actual rendering checks instead of CDN assumptions.
Preserve source UI metadata and invocation policy exactly.
Retain Matt Pocock MIT attribution in every refactored package.

deltas.change: Permit no justified candidates and separate evidence from speculative payoff.
deltas.reason: A survey should not manufacture cleanup demand.
deltas.tradeoff: Some runs produce a short report instead of attractive diagrams.

deltas.change: Retain hot-spot scoping but relate candidates to actual upcoming changes.
deltas.reason: Recent churn alone can reflect generated code or mechanical edits.
deltas.tradeoff: May need one additional source of context.

deltas.change: Use offline HTML with inline CSS/SVG and inspect rendering when possible.
deltas.reason: The supplied self-contained report depends on remote scripts and can silently fail.
deltas.tradeoff: More manual diagram layout, less automatic graph rendering.

deltas.change: Report first, then explore only a selected candidate; honor report-only requests.
deltas.reason: Source docs describe unwanted long interviews before options.
deltas.tradeoff: The process ends before an implementation-ready design unless selected.

deltas.change: Record recurring rejected candidates only for durable reasons and actual user decision.
deltas.reason: Temporary deprioritization is not a permanent architecture prohibition.
deltas.tradeoff: Some suggestions may recur when conditions change.

deltas.change: Omit Claude-only disable-model-invocation frontmatter while copying agents/openai.yaml explicit-only policy.
deltas.reason: The target is Codex packaging; its metadata preserves invocation intent and the bundled validator accepts the supported frontmatter.
deltas.tradeoff: This package is not a byte-identical Claude entrypoint.
